systems.system: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system
systems.country_label: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system; vital registration system (birth and death registration)
systems.owner: Registration Insolvency and Trusteeship Agency (RITA), under the Ministry of Constitution and Legal Affairs; vital statistics managed by the National Bureau of Statistics
systems.tiers: Births, deaths and causes of death collected at health facilities and in the community and reported by health workers to RITA; some health facilities to be designated registration centres under the CRVS strategy; described in May 2019 as not fully operational, capturing a very low percentage of births and only facility-based deaths

systems.owner: Prime Minister's Office; hamlet chairperson reports to the village executive officer
systems.tiers: Village level: a register of village residents, updated as births or deaths occur

systems.system: Interoperability of RITA data systems with health facility systems
systems.owner: RITA with the Ministry of Health and PO-RALG
systems.tiers: Required by the guidelines, to avoid duplicate work by health workers; the CRVS feed into DHIS is described as under development

note: Health ministry guidelines of May 2019: they say who governs civil registration, that health workers report births and deaths to RITA and that the system is not fully operational, and cite the National CRVS Strategy 2015/16-2020/21, but never say whether or where a birth or death is entered as a digital record, so the system is unclassified and gives no fact.
